meta.name: setup-timescaledb-hypertables
meta.description:
Use this skill when creating database schemas or tables for Timescale, TimescaleDB, TigerData, or Tiger Cloud, especially for time-series, IoT, metrics, events, or log data. Use this to improve the performance of any insert-heavy table.

**Trigger when user asks to:**
- Create or design SQL schemas/tables AND Timescale/TimescaleDB/TigerData/Tiger Cloud is available
- Set up hypertables, compression, retention policies, or continuous aggregates
- Configure partition columns, segment_by, order_by, or chunk intervals
- Optimize time-series database performance or storage
- Create tables for sensors, metrics, telemetry, events, or transaction logs

**Keywords:** CREATE TABLE, hypertable, Timescale, TimescaleDB, time-series, IoT, metrics, sensor data, compression policy, continuous aggregates, columnstore, retention policy, chunk interval, segment_by, order_by

Step-by-step instructions for hypertable creation, column selection, compression policies, retention, continuous aggregates, and indexes.

copy.tagline_en: Create and optimize hypertables for time-series data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are using TimescaleDB for large time-series data and need performance optimization.

howto.what: 当你在 TimescaleDB 中创建或设计数据库表时，Claude 会指导你一步步设置超表、压缩、保留策略和连续聚合，以优化时间序列数据的存储和查询性能。
howto.when: 当你要求创建 SQL 表且涉及 TimescaleDB、TigerData 或 Tiger Cloud，或者提到超表、压缩、保留策略、连续聚合等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我为传感器数据创建一个超表。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含时间戳、设备ID等列的建表语句。

say.text: 设置压缩策略，7天后压缩数据。
创建每小时聚合视图并设置刷新策略。
say.note: Claude 会创建连续聚合视图并配置刷新策略。

howto.what_en: When you create or design database tables in TimescaleDB, Claude guides you step-by-step to set up hypertables, compression, retention policies, and continuous aggregates to optimize storage and query performance for time-series data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create SQL tables involving TimescaleDB, TigerData, or Tiger Cloud, or mention hypertables, compression, retention policies, continuous aggregates, etc.

say_en.text: Create a hypertable for sensor data.
say_en.note: Claude generates a CREATE TABLE statement with timestamp, device_id, etc.

say_en.text: Set up compression policy to compress after 7 days.
say_en.note: Claude calls add_columnstore_policy with the specified after interval.

say_en.text: Create hourly aggregate view with refresh policy.
say_en.note: Claude creates a continuous aggregate view and configures its refresh policy.
